facts.fact: 章首：连日骨汤维生身体酸痛虚软——炉边裹毯
facts.anchor: Bone broth had done little to sustain her over the last few days, and her body was sore and weak.

facts.fact: 阳台那人种下决心：苦练身体与魔法，再有人占便宜烧成灰
facts.anchor: if anyone tried to take advantage of her again, she would burn them to the fucking ground.

facts.fact: Rayner 送 Gyor 的女装皮具——花光余钱；兄弟修马厩抵房费
facts.anchor: I just got clothing for you from Gyor. I think it should fit.

facts.fact: Gyor 酒保交易：两名女招待回家照顾垂死父亲——她每晚帮工抵补给；Done
facts.anchor: “My two barmaids recently left. Sisters. Said they had to care for their dying father.

facts.fact: 庇护所原则：光暗生物同席——不求成友但求互解
facts.anchor: “This tavern is a place of refuge for all kinds of creatures and men.”

facts.fact: Quentin 手语：不强迫 kitzek 随行——它们可自行决定；Gyor 乐见其留吓退怪物
facts.anchor: “’That’s not our decision to make,’” Rayner translated for Quentin.

facts.fact: 袭击后首次复练：掌心小火+烙圆入土——魔法重新苏醒
facts.anchor: Andra hadn’t tried to use her magic since the assault, but the morning cold was biting into her fingers

facts.fact: Gerrick 晨跑：黑漩涡纹身沿右肋到右臂全覆盖——与幻象里 Edgeron 黑纹同构、脊背发凉
facts.anchor: the black swirling tattoos that spanned his chest and ran down the right side of his ribcage

facts.fact: 兽群嗅他即亲翻肚讨摸——他自辩“分不清怪物和生物就是烂猎人”、kitzek 是心头好
facts.anchor: I would be a really shitty hunter if I didn’t know the difference between monster and creature.

facts.fact: 情报交易：名字换名字——报出 Gerrick 时脸上掠过最淡阴影
facts.anchor: “Gerrick,” he answered, and the faintest of shadows crossed his face.

facts.fact: 南林之行的解释（买甜酒）被她判定鬼话；后文“他没看过她的全部”
facts.anchor: “The market in the Southern Woods offers an unparalleled experience. The sweet wine alone is worth a special trip.”

facts.fact: 三男前臂相握秒熟——聊食谱与动物解放如多年老友；Gerrick 问起救兽者
facts.anchor: “Pleasure to meet you, Gerrick. I’m Rayner, and this is Quentin, my brother.”
